confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cartagena price levels for a July 2026 window; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most solid. Hostel and hotel rates are least certain because they swing with July holiday demand and the Old City and Getsemani premium. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the local beer relationship because direct price knowledge is weak. Peso examples assume a recent exchange-rate range, so USD values may drift if the peso moves. The FX observation comes from two rba.gov.au search results that agreed on the 15 October 2026 value; the live RBA table was not opened directly and should be rechecked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis: Colombia's large tourist cities and Caribbean-coast resort cities in Latin America, with a premium for the historic center and Getsemani in July.
